zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空將開航西雅圖至雅典與巴黎直飛航線
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空宣佈將於2027年春季開航西雅圖至雅典與巴黎直飛航線。
body: 阿拉斯加航空（Alaska Airlines）宣佈，將於2027年春季開航由西雅圖塔科馬國際機場（SEA）飛往希臘雅典國際機場（CDG）（ATH）與法國巴黎戴高樂機場的全新直飛航線。兩條航線的機票已於2026年8月20日正式開賣。
其中，西雅圖至雅典航線（航班號AS196）預計於2027年5月12日首航，每週營運三班；西雅圖至巴黎航線（航班號AS136）則預計於2027年5月25日首航，每週營運五班。兩條航線均將採用波音787-9（Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner）客機執飛。
阿拉斯加航空執行長班·米尼庫奇（Ben Minicucci）表示，航空公司正致力於未來數年內開闢超過12條自西雅圖出發的國際長途航線，以擴大其全球航網佈局。

en.title: Alaska Airlines to Launch Nonstop Flights from Seattle to Ath (ATH)ens and Paris
en.summary: Alaska Airlines will launch nonstop flights from Seattle to Athens and Paris starting in spring 2027.
body: Alaska Airlines has announced that it will launch new nonstop service from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) to Athens International Airport  and Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) starting in spring 2027. Tickets for both transcontinental routes went on sale on August 20, 2026.

The route to Athens, designated as flight AS196, is scheduled to launch on May 12, 2027, with three weekly flights. Service to Paris, designated as flight AS136, will begin on May 25, 2027, operating five times weekly. Both long-haul services will be operated using Boeing 787-9 aircraft.

Ben Minicucci, Chief Executive Officer of Alaska Airlines, stated that the carrier is working toward operating more than 12 international long-haul routes from Seattle in the coming years to expand its global connectivity.
